subject.title: Bug: google-vertex provider merged into google transport path in 2026.3.28 (regression)

question: Should this issue close on the shipped native transport/ADC fixes alone, or remain open until the linked Google Vertex setup/auth PR path is accepted or superseded?
rationale: The runtime over-merge is fixed in source and release, but the open linked PRs intentionally change onboarding, auth evidence, and setup defaults, which are compatibility-sensitive product surfaces.

options.title: Keep Paired With Vertex Setup Path
options.body: Leave this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60736 and the linked PRs decide the remaining Google Vertex setup/auth contract.

options.title: Close On Runtime Fix Only
options.body: Close this issue as implemented by the shipped native transport and ADC fixes, while leaving broader onboarding work to the canonical issue.

options.title: Supersede Into Canonical Issue
options.body: Close this issue as a duplicate of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60736 if maintainers want one open tracker for all remaining Google Vertex auth/setup work.

recommendation.title: Keep Paired With Vertex Setup Path
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60736 and the linked PRs decide the remaining Google Vertex setup/auth contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The open proof-supplied PR from this owner is the clearest current vehicle for the remaining setup/auth decision.
